# Project Trinity: Shatterbound

> Project Trinity: Shatterbound is a dungeon crawler built around the Holy Trinity of MMO raiding: a tank, a healer and DPS. The player swaps into any hero of a four-hero party mid-fight, and the AI plays the rest, playing to win like a raid team chasing day-one clears. It is made by Project Trinity Studios and is in alpha, with builds for Windows, Mac and Linux.

- Genre: a hub-based dungeon crawler with MMO-style boss fights.
- Play: alone, or with a friend on one split screen. Online co-op is a goal, not yet in the game.
- The party: Bastion (Tank), Oracle (Healer), Reaver (melee DPS) and Asha (ranged DPS). More characters and more dungeons are planned.
- The bosses: Patchwork (Patchwork's Hunt), the Giant (the Giant's Gate), Old Hunger (the Feeding Pit) and Maera (the Lightless Shoal). Don Fortuna is coming.
- Made in Unity, with every dungeon and set piece made in Blender. The animations, music and sound effects are licensed packs. AI tools and AI-generated assets were used in making the game.
- Project Trinity is also the name of the research behind the game: the AI party itself, how it plays, and how the research is done (fights simulated in the cloud).
- Studio: Project Trinity Studios. Contact: hello@projecttrinity.dev. Video: https://www.youtube.com/@ProjectTrinityStudios
